title: [crash] double free detected in tcache 2

labels.name: has:vim-patch
labels.description: issue is fixed in vim and patch needs to be ported

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.6.0-dev+561-g03b805aee

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

Cannot tell as the plugin I am using does not support vim

### Operating system/version

Manjaro Linux

### Terminal name/version

alacritty 0.9.0 (fed349aa)

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

build from repo

### How to reproduce the issue

1. nvim -u vimrc foo.c
2. :CocFzfList symbols
3. press escape
4. :CocFzfList symbols
5. press escape
6. wait for a couple of seconds

vimrc:
```vim
call plug#begin('./plugins')
Plug 'neoclide/coc.nvim', {'branch': 'release'}
Plug 'junegunn/fzf', {'dir': '~/.fzf','do': './install --all'}
Plug 'junegunn/fzf.vim'
Plug 'antoinemadec/coc-fzf', {'commit': '2d9deb2a3b05a0c09f01edda0a4abd542cb3eebd'}
call plug#end()
```

foo.c:
```c
int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
  return 0;
}
```

### Expected behavior

No crash.

### Actual behavior

Crash with message: 
```
free(): double free detected in tcache 2
{                                       Aborted (core dumped)
```
